beforeSigner.qualifiedFor: current direct signing key and approved public lineage only

initContainers.name: prepare-node-sockets
command:
set -eu
umask 077
if [ "$(stat -c '%u:%g:%a' /cmtc-node-sockets)" != '0:0:755' ]; then exit 30; fi
for name in agent admin; do
 p=/cmtc-node-sockets/$name
 if [ -e "$p" ] || [ -L "$p" ]; then
  if [ ! -d "$p" ] || [ -L "$p" ]; then exit 31; fi
  if [ "$(stat -c '%u:%g:%a' "$p")" != '1000:1000:700' ]; then exit 32; fi
 else
  mkdir -m 700 "$p"
  chown 1000:1000 "$p"
 fi
done
